purpose: Monitor credit accumulation, academic performance, and risk status to support graduation planning.
audience: Academic advisors and graduation office staff.

kpis.name: Total Credits Earned by Year
kpis.limitations: Summed per year; assumes all records belong to the same year dimension.

kpis.name: Average GPAX
kpis.limitations: Average of GPA values; does not weight by credit load.

kpis.name: Students at Risk
kpis.limitations: Counts only students flagged as AT_RISK; other readiness categories excluded.

kpis.name: Graduation Readiness Distribution
kpis.limitations: Limited to three readiness categories; may not reflect nuanced readiness.

kpis.name: Total Students
kpis.limitations: Counts distinct students across all records; no additional filters applied.

display_labels.Graduation_Readiness: สถานะการสำเร็จการศึกษา
display_labels.Risk_Level: ระดับความเสี่ยง
display_labels.Program_Mode: รูปแบบโปรแกรม

charts.title: Total Credits Earned by Year
charts.limitations: Year dimension derived from date fields; assumes consistent BE year.

charts.title: Graduation Readiness Distribution
charts.limitations: Limited to three readiness categories; small sample size.

charts.title: Average GPAX over Year
charts.limitations: GPAX values may not be comparable across years without normalization.

charts.title: จำนวนนักศึกษาตามสถานะการสำเร็จการศึกษา
charts.limitations: Limited to three readiness categories; small sample size.

insight_questions: Which student groups are at risk of not meeting credit requirements?
How does average GPAX trend over recent years?
Is the total credit accumulation on track to meet graduation requirements?
What is the distribution of graduation readiness categories across risk levels?
last_instruction: เพิ่มกราฟแท่งจำนวนนักศึกษาตามสถานะการสำเร็จการศึกษา โดยคงกราฟและ KPI เดิมไว้ทั้งหมด
